comparison.objective: Close a camera’s articulated vari-angle screen with the glass facing the camera body; body and specs provide no further rubric.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-panel orientation and folding, unlike coaxial mandrel placement, controlled hammer impact, notch fracture, and loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Apparently requires the screen to be shut in the specified orientation; no numeric tolerances, damage rules, or spec versions are available.
comparison.reason: The tested outcome and central mechanism are meaningfully different: hinge-mediated screen closure versus contact-driven HELICOIL tang fracture and containment. Missing thresholds do not create a plausible duplicate here.
